decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: The supported CLI changes from a single record to streamed ordered batches; retained writes, duplicate replacement, normalized file contents, stdout/stderr and exit codes are consumer contracts.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: This is Go implementation and test writing; use standard-library dependencies, explicit early error returns, contextual errors and gofmt.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: No interface, constructor, options, dependency wiring or resource ownership change is necessary; keep the existing io.Reader/io.Writer boundary and synchronous file writes.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: The existing command package already owns CSV import and file writes; the change extends its supported record count without creating, moving or splitting packages or responsibilities.

unavailable_guidance: The two new testing-writing skills were unavailable and were not opened.
